prayerExcerpt.en-US: That through progress in learning we may come to a deeper knowledge and love of you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Possamos conhecer-vos e amar-vos mais profundamente.

meta.face: An old man of about seventy-five, clean-shaven, with a large, heavy, broad face — a wide, square, jowled jaw, a big, slightly fleshy nose, small, keen, heavy-lidded grey eyes under low, straight white brows, a wide, thin, firmly set mouth and deep lines from nose to mouth; a white Dominican tonsure ring of short hair under the mitre; a shrewd, patient, scholarly gaze lifted slightly from the page.
meta.basis: Tommaso da Modena's fresco in the chapter house of San Niccolò, Treviso (1352), within living memory of him, shows a clean-shaven, heavy-jawed old bishop in the Dominican habit and mitre with a book; the card keeps that broad, heavy face. Cologne, where he taught and died, is the setting; the sphere, plants and crystal stand for his natural science.
